## UX checklist

| Check                                                                                   | Engineering | Design (Dani) | QA (Quincy) |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ------------- | ----------- |
| Hover, pressed, and focus ring                                                          |             |               |             |
| Pointer cursor on clickable controls                                                    |             |               |             |
| Disabled, empty, no-results, loading, and error states                                  |             |               |             |
| Success feedback for every action                                                       |             |               |             |
| WCAG contrast: 4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI, and hover/pressed (hover is not a fill change alone) |             |               |             |
| No wrapping or overflow at 390, 768, and 1280                                           |             |               |             |
| 44px hit areas                                                                          |             |               |             |
| No internal jargon in user-facing strings                                               |             |               |             |
| Focus management after actions and dialogs                                              |             |               |             |
| Alert and live-region roles                                                             |             |               |             |
